properties.name: Göbekli Tepe
properties.description: Published Taş Tepeler site on the Germuş limestone, and a UNESCO World Heritage property. It is a known validation site for this project, not a discovery.
properties.notes: Official listing coordinates. 30 m terrain cannot resolve individual enclosures or pillars.

properties.name: Karahan Tepe
properties.description: Published Taş Tepeler excavation on the Tektek plateau. It is a known validation site for this project, not a discovery.
properties.notes: Public encyclopedia coordinates of a published excavation. Not a new find.

properties.name: Sayburç
properties.description: Published Pre-Pottery Neolithic site in the Şanlıurfa plateau, associated with the Taş Tepeler work.
properties.notes: Public encyclopedia coordinates. The pin is not a surveyed plan.

properties.name: Harbetsuvan Tepesi
properties.description: Published Pre-Pottery Neolithic site on the Tektek plateau.
properties.notes: Public encyclopedia coordinates. The pin is not a surveyed plan.

properties.name: Nevalı Çori
properties.description: Published Pre-Pottery Neolithic site. It now lies under the Atatürk reservoir.
properties.notes: The published location is submerged by the Atatürk reservoir. The pin is not a place on dry ground you can visit, and the 30 m surface here is the reservoir landscape, not the excavated settlement.

properties.name: Harran
properties.description: Historic town on the Harran plain. A landscape landmark, not a Taş Tepeler Neolithic site.
properties.notes: Included so the plain has a known landmark. Not a Neolithic discovery and not part of the Taş Tepeler group.
